newsitem.title: USA: Duff & Phelps lowers Loewen Group rating.
newsitem.headline: Duff & Phelps lowers Loewen Group rating.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Friday it lowered ratings on the senior guaranteed notes of Loewen Group International Inc and Loewen Group Inc to Double B Minus from Triple B Minus.
In addition, the rating on Loewen's convertible first preferred shares Series C receipts and Leowen Group Capital's monthly income preferred securities were lowered to Double B Minus from Double B.
The ratings were removed from rating watch-down where they were placed June 18. A total of $830 million of debt and preferred securities are affected by the rating action.
The rating downgrade results from increased concern that Loewen will defer new common equity issues, which would support the aggressive acquisition program, Duff & Phelps said.
Loewen expects to complete more than $600 million in acquisitions in 1996, topping the prior year's record level of nearly $500 million.
